VBO:0201090.summary: Affectionate company and lively play can go together in Pug–Labrador crosses. Brandi enjoyed meeting people and sitting close, while Taz looked forward to weekly daycare, playing with friends and outdoor pull-toy games. Chico was a settled companion who walked well on a lead. These individual lives show room for both sociable activity and quieter company.
